verdict.pick: iReliev Wireless TENS + EMS Muscle Stimulator
verdict.line: Buy this if you want a wireless unit that also offers EMS for muscle recovery; it’s praised by multiple reviewers for its versatility. The main catch is that it may lack some advanced program options found in pricier models.
